text:
I've fixed everything I found in `catalog/`, but I haven't run `python3 -m unittest`. I have no command-execution tool here, so please run it to confirm.

The fixes:
- **`fees.py`:** the late fee was `days_late + DAILY_FEE`. It is now `days_late * DAILY_FEE`.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` was 3, though the comment and tests say five. It is now 5.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` returned `n + 1` events because of the `[-n - 1:]` slice. It now returns the last `n`, and an empty list when `n` is 0 or less.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books()` was missing `Emma`. I added `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`. The tests don't check author, year or copies for it, so I took those values from the `Emma` book in `tests/test_search.py`.
- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` left `year` as a string. It now converts it to an `int`.
- **`search.py`:** it imported `normalize` from `catalog.nonexistent`. It now imports from `catalog.text`.

I didn't modify any tests.
